summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kickoff in the 2026/27 season, having recently tested themselves against St Helens in what proved to be a competitive pre-season match. The club has bolstered the squad with several exciting new signings plus a returning player, and they're sporting three brand new kits for the campaign ahead. If you're interested in getting involved as a sponsor, now's the time to get in touch with the Ramblers as they build towards their promotion push.
